Name: Ajanta Caves
Description: Rock-cut Buddhist cave monuments dating from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE. Famous for their ancient paintings and sculptures.

Name: Ellora Caves
Description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain monuments carved out of rock. Includes the famous Kailasa temple.

Name: Elephanta Caves
Description: A network of sculpted caves on Elephanta Island. Famous for rock-cut art and sculptures dedicated to Lord Shiva.

Name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus
Description: A historic railway station in Mumbai and an outstanding example of Victorian Gothic Revival architecture.

Name: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai
Description: A collection of 19th-century Victorian Gothic and 20th-century Art Deco buildings. Unique blend of architectural styles.
